Name: Suresh Kumar
Bio:
Prof Suresh Kumar is a Professor of Mathematics at Plaksha University and Director of the Doctoral Program. He is interested in mathematics education and develops e-notes, video lectures, and AI- and Python-assisted learning modules for students.

Student resources: https://sites.google.com/site/sureshkumaryd/home/student-resources
Research_Summary:
Prof Kumar investigates cosmological models, especially dark matter, dark energy, cosmic acceleration, and tensions within the standard ΛCDM model. He uses Bayesian analysis of observational data, Monte Carlo Markov Chain methods, CLASS, and MontePython.

Areas of work:

Dark matter and dark energy

Cosmic acceleration and cosmological tensions

Bayesian analysis of cosmological models

Observational datasets and computational cosmology
Research_Interests: Bayesian Data Analysis of cosmological models | Dark Matter, Dark Energy, Cosmic Acceleration, Anisotropic Cosmological Models | Bayesian Data Analysis
